ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
OR( AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", OR( ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Customer int number assgnmnt - DEBI"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "QioDebitoren Europäische Union - DEEU"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Ship To - W002"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Ship To - H002") ), ISBLANK(Shipping_Condition__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", OR( ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Bill To - 0001"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Ship To - 0002") ), ISBLANK(Shipping_Condition__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", OR( ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Customer-Ship To"), ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Customer-Payer") ), ISBLANK(Shipping_Condition__c) ),
AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "Ship-to party - 0002"), ISBLANK(Shipping_Condition__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipping Conditions can not be blank
